Injects GRE and inner IPv4 headers into packet files.

# Purpose
This script reads raw packet files, parses the Ethernet and IPv4 headers, and writes modified packet files with a GRE header and an inner IPv4 header inserted. The main packet logic is in [`inject_gre_and_inner_ip`](<#inject_gre_and_inner_ip>), which keeps the original payload, updates the outer IPv4 protocol field to GRE, recalculates the outer IPv4 checksum, and builds a new packet frame. Helper functions such as [`parse_ethernet_header`](<#parse_ethernet_header>), [`parse_ipv4_header`](<#parse_ipv4_header>), [`create_gre_header`](<#create_gre_header>), [`create_inner_ipv4_header`](<#create_inner_ipv4_header>), and [`calculate_ipv4_checksum`](<#calculate_ipv4_checksum>) handle header parsing and packet field construction.

The file also acts as a command-line tool for batch processing. The [`process_packet_files`](<#process_packet_files>) function uses a file pattern to find input packet files, processes each file, and writes the modified output to a target directory with a `_gre` suffix. The [`main`](<#main>) function defines the command-line interface with `argparse`, so the script can be run directly to transform packet files without importing it as a library.
